text.en: Students and salon clients praise instructors Cathy and Michaela for their thorough knowledge and encouraging teaching manner. Trainees frequently mention that hands-on mentoring builds practical confidence rapidly. Both pet owners and course participants note that the instructors remain patient and accessible.

Reviewers consistently praise the calm, pleasant environment within the salon and training centre in Sandyford. Course attendees appreciate the comfortable learning atmosphere that reduces pressure while practicing techniques. The facility maintains a supportive setting where dogs and students feel relaxed.

Trainees and grooming customers observe that dogs are handled with patience, kindness, and genuine respect for animal welfare. Handlers work with a broad spectrum of dog breeds and coat types, accommodating varying temperaments. Clients highlight that pets return home settled, neat, and well cared for.

q.en: Does Canine Creations offer accredited dog grooming courses?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that the centre provides accredited vocational diploma courses, including practical salon management and hand-stripping techniques.

q.en: Can students complete training courses on a flexible schedule?

a.en: Yes, course participants mention completing training modules part-time to balance existing work commitments.

q.en: Are specialized breed grooming techniques such as hand stripping provided?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight dedicated hand stripping sessions for wire-haired breeds alongside full commercial styling.

q.en: Where is the salon and school located?

a.en: The premises are situated in Sandyford Village in South Dublin, opposite St. Marys Church.
